claims.statement: Each declared task's exact in-process Python implementation has ten successful completion samples for the retained workload.

For the measured exact-source in-process workload, preview_vote_total completes in less than 16ms and commit_vote_total completes in less than 50ms; this claim makes no browser, network, or persistence promise.

In the declared conditional flow model, assuming vote.commit recurs between 100ms and 200ms and snapshot.render occupies a renderer for between 500ms and 1000ms, two renderer workers have sufficient snapshot-work after warm-up from two initial units.
assumptions: vote.commit recurs between 100 ms and 200 ms.
snapshot.render service duration remains between 500 ms and 1000 ms.

claims.statement: In the declared conditional flow model, assuming the stated vote.commit cadence and summary.advance service envelope, three summarizer workers provide enough modeled service capacity to keep summary-lag at or below its declared three-generation capacity.
assumptions: The declared vote.commit cadence and summary.advance service envelope hold.
